diagnosis.what_happened: academic-writer copied a .md file to a .docx extension (cp .md .docx), academic-orchestrator failed to require .docx synchronization, and validation-agent passed the stage without verifying .docx integrity.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: The .docx file was a corrupt plaintext copy rather than a valid OpenXML document, completely desynchronizing the deliverable triad.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Agents must generate valid binary OpenXML .docx files via python-docx. The orchestrator must enforce the Triad/Dyad Deliverable Invariant for all formats, and the validation-agent must physically verify .docx format integrity and cross-format text concordance.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Circumventing proper binary document generation (Directive 25) corrupts deliverables, while validation blindspots allow defective outputs to graduate to the user.

desired_behavior: Generate true binary OpenXML for .docx files using python-docx. Enforce Dyad/Triad synchronization. Validate .docx binary integrity strictly.
generalization: Never substitute true binary format generation with plaintext copying. Multi-format deliverables must be generated independently using appropriate libraries and verified comprehensively.
